title: Capital Structure Intelligence V2 — issuer state contract (capital_structure.state.v2)
description: Frozen same-owner state/scenario contract (masterplan research/capital_structure/e2e_20261013/MASTERPLAN.md §9, task C0). The root record is a CapitalState generation; $defs carry every planned-interface record (state_request, capital_inputs, rule_pack, financing_scenario, capacity_envelope, supply_envelope, funding_schedule, instrument_set, share_basis_result, calculation_receipt). Compatible with capital_structure.projection_bundle.v1, which is never renamed and keeps its observed-event reader. Unknown is never 0 or infinity; every share quantity names its basis; shared-pool maxima are never summed; a numeric bound without applicability evidence is rejected; a changed assumption is a different scenario identity. Context only: no rank, sizing, entry or Prophet authority.
